data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, October 20, 2026: Crypto prices slide and oil costs soar as Mid-East attacks persist
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $81,844.43 on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, down 0.2% from Monday's open. As of 7:31 a.m. ET this morning, bitcoin fell to $81,405.30. Ethereum opened at $2,405.06, down 0.2% compared to Monday's opening price. The price of ethereum edged lower this morning to $2,384.13 as of 7:31 a.m. ET.
